Breach 0.2.1

Maintenance release of Breach 0.2 Beta.

Releases now use GitHub for signed downloads and the update feed. Build numbers identify each archive, and a beta build can become stable without rebuilding the app.

This build uses ad-hoc code signing and is not Apple-notarized. Sparkle verifies the feed and download using Breach's existing Ed25519 signing key.

Breach 0.2.1

Fixes selective routing failures after extended use. Fake-IP DNS mappings now survive unrelated DNS lookups and engine restarts, so applications can continue using cached addresses.

Breach retains these routing mappings in a private local cache. Redir-host mode and disabled DNS keep their existing behavior.

This build uses ad-hoc code signing and is not Apple-notarized. Sparkle verifies the feed and download using Breach's existing Ed25519 signing key.

Breach 0.4 Beta

Software updates reinstall an existing network helper after relaunch and verify it before restoring your connection. macOS asks for administrator permission to authorize the updated helper.

If authorization is declined or helper verification fails, Breach stays disconnected and opens Settings → Permissions to retry. Updates also replace the helper when Breach was disconnected, and keep it uninstalled if it was not present before the update.

The network helper controls System Proxy and Enhanced Mode. It accepts only the updated signed app and its bundled command-line tool.

Breach 0.4 Beta

GENERAL UPDATES

- Third-party notices now open in a resizable window with selectable text.
- Automatic subscription updates now default to every hour. Existing preferences are preserved.

SOFTWARE UPDATES

- New downloads use DMG disk images with an Applications shortcut.
- After beta opt-in, the Stable/Beta selector stays available when switching to Stable or restarting Breach.
- Updates now replace the installed network helper before reconnecting.
- Added a password notice before installation. macOS requests administrator permission after relaunch.
- If helper setup fails or permission is declined, Breach stays disconnected and opens Settings → Permissions.

BUG FIXES

- Fixed spacing and arrow alignment in the Profiles actions menu.
- Fixed Settings sidebar icons not following the selected accent color.
- Fixed the map forgetting the departure city after reopening or restarting Breach.

This beta is not Apple-notarized.

Breach 0.6 Beta

GENERAL UPDATES

- Explore your routes in Apple Maps. Switch between 2D and 3D, zoom out to see the globe, and use your trackpad to move, zoom and rotate the map.
- Choose a departure city or time period with one click. The arrow above the zoom buttons smoothly brings you back to your departure point.
- You can use your current location as the departure point. The location links open the right page in macOS Settings, and Breach tries again when you return. Breach does not save your location.
- Move the pointer near the left edge to reveal a hidden sidebar. It stays closed while you are moving the map. Map now sits directly below Logs.
- Added glass styling throughout the app, including Settings and the profile editor.
- Customize keyboard shortcuts in Settings, directly below Permissions.
- Press Command-S to show or hide the sidebar, and Command-Shift-S to connect or disconnect. Command-Up/Down moves between sections in the main window and Settings. Command-S still saves in editors.
- Hold Command for half a second to see navigation shortcuts beside sidebar items.
- Simplified Notifications settings and the introduction to Third-Party Notices.

BUG FIXES

- Planes now stay on their visible routes in 3D.
- Map buttons are easier to click and remain readable with every app color in light and dark mode. Click animations are back, without the flicker.
- Sidebar icons, text and status labels line up properly. Sidebar buttons are easier to click, and the Energy saving leaf turns green.
- The connection buttons stay on the right when the app opens.
- The profile editor fits inside the import window. Text colors appear as soon as the editor opens, even for large files.
- Profile menus close smoothly, without the three dots flickering. Removed the extra storage message from the Profiles page.
- Location errors appear once, and the location message disappears once Breach finds your location.
- Settings errors show the explanation without the extra "Not saved" text.

macOS may show a security warning when you open this beta because it has not been checked by Apple.
